name: – After § 4 – Am 1
title: Resolution on the case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
part_text: 4a. Is concerned that despite the deterioration of the rule of law and freedoms in Türkiye, the EU continues to subsidise institutions linked to the government of Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, such as Gaziantep University, which is associated with the Erasmus+ programme and has received an EU grant of EUR 250 000, while its professors and staff regularly celebrate the actions of Hamas and other Islamist organisations;
